name: dispatch_contention
supersedes: protocol-v2.json (v2r1 both devices: no declared candidate accepted; reading in its last addendum)
mechanisms: resource.fma_smsp / instruction.service issue_interval_cycles of the fma_smsp classes (candidate P, kept for comparison)
question: v2r1 measured (both devices, identical): forms with three general-purpose register (GPR) reads not served by the operand reuse cache cost 2 SMSP issue cycles when warps interleave (dep3r 4 / 5 / 6 / 8 for W = 1..4, ilp2 pair 2 + 1 -> 3 / 4.5 / 6, mixed FFMA 2 + FMNMX 1 -> 6 at W = 4), forms with one or two GPR reads cost 1 (dep3n 2 reads, dep2 / dep1 1 read: 4 / 4 / 4 / 4), and the reuse-served stream issues 1 / cycle (ilp8). Integer: dep3r W = 4 is 8.00, not 6. Is the rule 'at most two GPR operand reads per SMSP per cycle, an instruction holds the SMSP's operand collector for ceil(unserved GPR reads / 2) cycles' (candidates OP2q / OP2x / OP2s: an in-order collector queue behind the issue slot, an exclusive hold, or an exclusive hold whose spare port slot the same warp's next instruction may share) the one, once the constants are forced into GPRs (v2 had them in uniform registers, so dep3n / dep2 / ilp8n2 measured 2 / 1 / 1 reads instead of 3 / 2 / 2 and ilp8n failed its gate)?

engine_rules_declared_before_data.baseline: as protocol v2 (present engine; class issue intervals <= 1.1 taken as 1.0 in the replica, v2 addendum 1).
engine_rules_declared_before_data.OP2q (operand ports, in-order collector: the SMSP issues (selects) at most one instruction per cycle as today, and the control-word stall floor and the result latency count from that issue cycle; behind the issue slot a per-SMSP operand collector serves the issued instructions in order, each for ceil(n / 2) cycles (n = distinct GPRs read from the register file; a GPR named twice counts once, a 64-bit pair counts both registers; uniform registers, predicates, immediates, constant-bank operands and RZ do not count; n = 0 takes no service), service start = max(issue cycle, previous service end); the SMSP may not issue a further instruction while the most recently issued one with n > 0 has not yet started its service (one instruction in service, at most one waiting). A GPR operand is not read when served by the reuse cache: the same warp's immediately preceding instruction (program order) carried the reuse flag on that operand slot with the same register and that instruction was the SMSP's immediately preceding issue (v1 r2: dep3r with reuse flags on every instruction still cost 2W once warps interleaved). Class units stay as installed. Leaf: register_file.operand_read.reads_per_cycle = 2, collector = 1 (queue). v2r1 dry run (replica): fits every usable cell on both devices -- dep3r 4 / 6 / 8 (W = 1, 3, 4), dep3n / dep2 / dep1 4 / 4 / 4 / 4, ilp2 2.0 / 3.0 / 4.5 / 6.0 (measured 2.0 / 3.0 / 4.3 / 6.0), ilp8 1.0, ilp8n2 1.0, imad 4 / 4 / 6 / 8, mixed 5 / 5 / 5.0 / 6.0 (measured 5 / 5 / 5 / 6: the queue removes the bunching that made the exclusive forms predict 7.35) -- except dep3r W = 2 (4 against 5, the recorded anomaly). Engine shape: per SMSP two cycle counters (service end of the last entry, service start of the last entry); try_issue blocks while the last start is in the future (resource bucket), commit sets start = max(now, end), end = start + cost.
engine_rules_declared_before_data.OP2x (operand ports, exclusive): a per-SMSP operand collector admitting one instruction at a time: an issued instruction holds it for ceil(n / 2) cycles, n = number of distinct GPRs it reads from the register file (a GPR named twice counts once; a 64-bit pair counts both registers; uniform registers, predicates, immediates, constant-bank operands and RZ do not count; n = 0 holds nothing); no other instruction of any warp issues during the hold. A GPR operand is not read when served by the reuse cache: the same warp's immediately preceding instruction (program order) carried the reuse flag on that operand slot with the same register and that instruction was the SMSP's immediately preceding issue (v1 r2: dep3r with reuse flags on every instruction still cost 2W once warps interleaved). Class units stay as installed. Leaf: register_file.operand_read.reads_per_cycle = 2, follower_shares_spare_port = 0. v2r1 dry run: fits every multi-warp cell (dep3r 6 / 8, ilp2 3 / 4.5 / 6, dep3n / dep2 / dep1 4, ilp8 1, imad, mixed W = 4 by hand) and misses ilp2 W = 1 (predicts 2.5: the single warp's second instruction waits for the first's 2-cycle hold and its stall-3 floor then lands at 5 per pair; measured 4).
engine_rules_declared_before_data.OP2s (operand ports, same-warp follower: as OP2x, except that the same warp's immediately next instruction (program order, no intervening issue) may issue in the last cycle of the hold when its own unserved reads fit the ports left free in that cycle (a 3-read hold uses 2 + 1 of the 2 x 2 port slots: a follower with <= 1 unserved read issues one cycle earlier); any other instruction waits for the hold to end. Leaf: reads_per_cycle = 2, follower_shares_spare_port = 1. v2r1 dry run: fits ilp2 W = 1 (2.0) and misses ilp2 W = 2..4 (predicts 2 / 3 / 4 against 3 / 4.3 / 6). The ilp8n W = 1 cell (single warp, 3 unserved reads per instruction) separates the two directly: OP2x 2.0, OP2s 1.5.
engine_rules_declared_before_data.O2x (banked, as v2): kept only as the alternative to OP2 that the data can separate: bank(r) = r mod 2, one read per bank per cycle, cost = max bank reads, exclusive collector, same reuse rule. It differs from OP2 on 2-read forms whose two registers have equal parity (cost 2 instead of 1) and on 3-read forms with all... three reads always share a bank under mod 2, so there both cost 2; the 2-read forms (dep2, ilp8n2, mixed FMNMX) are the separating cells.
engine_rules_declared_before_data.P (pipe pairing, as v2): kept as the class-level alternative: fma_smsp two copies at 2.0, second copy only right after the same warp's previous instruction; operand form plays no role.
engine_rules_declared_before_data.order rationale: OP2q is placed first among the operand-port forms because it is the only declared form that reproduces all of v2r1 (including the multi-class mixed cell and the single-warp ilp2 cell) without a second parameter; OP2x / OP2s are kept so that the v3 data can still prefer them if the ilp8n (3 unserved reads per instruction, single warp) cell contradicts the queue (OP2q and OP2x predict 2.0 there, OP2s 1.5).
engine_rules_declared_before_data.dropped: O4x / O2p / O4p (v2r1: O4x's prediction depends on the per-kernel allocation and h100's conflict-free U = 64 dep3r kernel still measured 8; the per-bank forms let a second warp slip into the ilp8 window, predicted 1.5 - 2.5 per warp against 1.00 measured).

probe: tools/microbench/dispatch_contention/probe/contention_v3.cu = contention_v2.cu with (1) every kernel-argument constant made NON-uniform and non-rematerialisable before t_s: each value is added to a per-lane zero loaded from a global buffer of zeros (float z = zeros[threadIdx.x], passed as a kernel argument pointer; v = args.x + z), so a, b, the dep3n ring, the mixed ring, the 16 ilp8n / 8 ilp8n2 constants and ia / ib all live in general-purpose registers that ptxas can neither keep in uniform registers nor re-load from the constant bank inside the window; (2) mufu.rcp and mufu.sin removed (v2: rcp(rcp(x)) folded by ptxas, sin expands); (3) everything else unchanged (variants dep3r dep3n dep2 dep1 ilp8 ilp8n ilp8n2 ilp2 imad mixed mufu.ex2 mufu.rsqrt mufu.lg2 mufu.tanh, U in {64, 128, 256}, W in {1..4}, both clocks per warp, CTA window, bar.sync per rep, --launches 16 --reps 65, two runs per device). Intended GPR read counts: dep3r 3, dep3n 3 (never reusable), dep2 2, dep1 1, ilp8 3 (reusable), ilp8n 3 (never reusable), ilp8n2 2 (never reusable), ilp2 3, imad 3, mixed FFMA 3 / FMNMX 2.
sass_gate: sass_check_v2.py unchanged (it records the operand kinds; the replica uses what was actually compiled). Additionally the gate output is checked by model_v3.py for the intended GPR read count per variant: a variant whose compiled window has a different count is still simulated with its real operands but flagged form_mismatch in the report.
derivation: as protocol v2 (per-warp and CTA slopes over U; replica model_v2.py extended with the OP2x / OP2s rules, invoked as model_v2.py <A> <dev> <run> --v3; each U kernel's own program; the two CS2R reads as 1-cycle instructions; class intervals <= 1.1 as 1.0).

decision.usable cell: as v2 (OLS residual <= 2 %, run agreement <= 3 % or <= 1 cycle per window, gate ok)
decision.gating cells: dep3r / dep3n / dep2 / dep1 at W in {1, 3, 4}; ilp8 / ilp8n / ilp8n2 / ilp2 / imad at W in {1, 2, 3, 4}; per-warp AND CTA slopes. Record only: dependent FP32 cells at W = 2 (v2 anomaly 5.00, unexplained), mixed at W >= 2 (v2 addendum 2: packing), mufu.*. A greedy cell (ilp8 / ilp8n / ilp8n2 at W >= 2) whose per-warp window is bimodal (OLS residual > 2 %) gates on its CTA slope alone (v2r1 b300: per-warp residual 0.05 - 0.25, CTA residual < 0.6 %).
decision.tolerance: per cell |predicted - measured| <= max(5 % of measured, 0.25 cycles per instruction)
decision.rule: per device the first candidate in the declared order that passes every usable gating cell is installed; none -> nothing, table reported, unrealised
decision.evidence: measured when the accepted candidate is within 5 % of each run's slope on every gating cell; else experimental

install.OP2q / OP2x / OP2s: common mechanism register_file.operand_read (event initialization, scope smsp): fields enabled (0 / 1), reads_per_cycle (2), collector (1 queue / 0 exclusive / 2 exclusive with follower sharing, per the accepted candidate); <arch>/leaves with source dispatch_contention.<device>.v3r<n>. Converter (python and cpp segment builders identical, py == cpp gate): REGS rows gain flags u8 (bit0 reuse_served: the static predecessor in program order carries the reuse flag on this operand slot with the same register; bit1 pair: 64-bit register-pair operand -- `.64`-suffixed names and the class table of pair-operand classes), format bump, formats.md. Engine: at issue n = distinct GPR source registers (pairs count 2) minus those with reuse_served when the SMSP's last issue was this warp's previous instance; the collector state is per SMSP (OP2q: last service start / end; OP2x / OP2s: next_free and spare slot), checked in resource_ready and committed with the issue (wait bucket resource); CTest fixtures: (a) single warp, 3-GPR-read independent stream, no reuse -> 2 cycles per instruction; (b) two warps' 3-read dependent chains -> 2 per instruction each (W = 2 -> 4 per step), three warps -> 6; (c) reuse-served stream -> 1 / cycle; (d) 2-read forms -> 1.
install.O2x: as v2 install O with banks 2, collector exclusive.
install.after install: tree build && tree validate --strict; py == cpp on the 5 standard cases; 500 x 2 A/B against hp $A/merge/rba, bw $A/merge/if36 (facts $A/merge/cbk); report row, status, docs/en/microbench.md

record_only.mufu ops: W = 1 chain slopes of ex2 / rsqrt / lg2 / tanh (v2r1: h100 all 17.0 vs installed MUFU 23, b300 17.95 vs 24, ex2 13.95 = installed MUFU.EX2 14). The installed 23 / 24 come from the service_latency rcp+add pair cell; a direct rcp chain cannot be compiled (ptxas folds). A service_latency addendum may split the MUFU class by op from these cells; not this protocol.
record_only.dep3r W = 2: 5.00 on both devices in v1 r2 and v2r1 against 4 from every rule

not_allowed: no case-cycle tuning; no values from other machines; no change of candidates, order, thresholds, gating set or variants after v3 data; the yield bit and the control-word stall counts are facts of the program and are not modelled here.

addenda.written_before: version 4; after reading v3r1 (h100-v3r1 / b300-v3r1, model_v2.py --v3)
addenda.text: (reading of v3r1) Probe: the per-lane zero made every constant a general-purpose register -- all 42 kernels pass the gate on both devices, no form_mismatch (dep3r / dep3n / ilp8 / ilp8n / ilp2 / imad 3 GPR reads, dep2 / ilp8n2 2, dep1 1), no LDC in any window. Measured per-warp slopes (both devices equal unless noted): dep3r 4 / 5 / 6 / 8; dep3n 4 / (3.86 h100, 4.50 b300) / 6 / 8 -- the v2 flat dep3n was the uniform-register form; dep2, dep1 4 / 4 / 4 / 4; ilp8 1.0; ilp8n **1.46 (h100, OLS residual 2.5 % -> excluded by the usability rule) / 1.50 (b300) at every W**; ilp8n2 1.0; ilp2 2 / 3 / 4.3 / 6; imad 4 / 4 / 6 / 7.85; mixed 5 / 5.25 / 5.25 / 6.25; mufu as v2r1. Decision by the letter: h100 accepts OP2q (measured; its ilp8n cells are excluded), b300 accepts nothing (ilp8n 1.50 against 2.00 from every operand-port form and 1.00 from baseline / P). Not installed on either device: the h100 acceptance rests on the exclusion of the one cell that contradicts it (1.46 vs 2.00, the same value as b300's usable 1.50). Reading: a single warp's stream of 3-read instructions costs 1.5 cycles each, so within one warp's consecutive stream the operand reads are pipelined at two per cycle across instruction boundaries (3 + 3 reads = 3 cycles), while an instruction after a warp switch (dep3r / dep3n / imad / mixed: 2 cycles each at W >= 3) and a reuse-served consumer (ilp2: pair 3 + served 1 = 3 cycles, not 2) start on a fresh cycle. Version 4 declares this pipelined form (OP2p) before measuring again; the probe is unchanged.
